question: Who won the 2024 Mathrubhumi Literary Award?
solution:
The Correct Answer is ​__**Sarah Joseph**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• Prominent writer Sarah Joseph conferred with Mathrubhumi Literary Award.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• 
 
**Sarah Joseph**, a **prominent Malayalam writer**, received the **2024 Mathrubhumi Literary Award**.

 
 
• 
 
The award was presented by **Jnanpith awardee Pratibha Ray** in **Kozhikode**.

 
 
• 
 
It includes:
 → a **cash prize of ₹3 lakh**,
 → a **citation**,
 → a **sculpture by M V Devan**.

 
 
• 
 
Sarah Joseph is also a recipient of:
 → the **Kerala Sahitya Akademi Award**,
 → the **Sahitya Akademi Award** for her novel **‘Aalahayude Penmakkal’**.
